subject.title: feat(ios): context-window usage indicator in the chat composer

question: Should OpenClaw accept this iOS/macOS composer context usage ring as the Android-parity slice of the linked mobile polish bundle once the freshness and proof gaps are fixed?
rationale: The patch adds a new visible mobile chat affordance tied to a maintainer-labeled product bundle, so automation can identify blockers but should not decide final product acceptance.

options.title: Accept After Focused Repairs
options.body: Keep this PR path, but require the history-sessionInfo freshness fix, clean merge state, and real visual/accessibility proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Behind Bundle Scoping
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader mobile polish issue is explicitly sequenced and prioritized by maintainers.

options.title: Reject Composer Meter Placement
options.body: Close or redirect this slice if maintainers want context visibility somewhere other than the composer toolbar.

recommendation.title: Accept After Focused Repairs
recommendation.body: Keep this PR path, but require the history-sessionInfo freshness fix, clean merge state, and real visual/accessibility proof before merge.
